summary: CL Workshop Group Ltd, a Macau-domiciled foreign private issuer traded on Nasdaq, filed a 6-K disclosing it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. Nasdaq notified the company on September 16, 2026, that the closing bid price of its ADSs (each representing eight Class A ordinary shares) held at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from September 1 to September 15, 2026. The prior deficiency, disclosed May 8, 2026, is now closed. No advisor, board recommendation, or deal terms were disclosed. Watch for renewed sub-$1 trading that could restart delisting pressure.
